content:
Early autumn Amazon Prime Day deals are officially underway. In addition to a US$50 discount on the brand-new Mac Studio, MacBook Air models with the M5 chip are also reduced by up to US$150. Meanwhile, we have also spotted the 2TB MacBook Pro with the M5 Pro (in Silver and Space Grey) marked down by a hefty US$500, ongoing clearance discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3, a range of TV deals, and fresh discounts on accessories from brands including Twelve South and Anker. See below for full details.

The MacBook Pro with the M5 Pro (in Silver and Space Grey) is reduced by US$500 on Amazon.

There are still plenty of attractive deals on the latest MacBook Air with the M5 chip, but we want to highlight again Amazon's massive US$500 discount on this M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 2TB of storage — both the Space Grey and Silver models are now available at this excellent price.

Amazon has now dropped the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage to US$2,699 with free shipping.

This is the lowest price we have tracked in recent months, and both the Space Grey and Silver versions are in stock — the latter is typically discounted less often.

This machine is originally priced at US$3,199, so you're saving US$500 straight off. As previously mentioned, with many tech deals merely restoring prices to older MSRPs, this discount is actually US$100 cheaper than the price before Apple's June price hike.

The cheapest 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is down US$100, with US$150 off the 24GB version

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB US$1,449 (originally US$1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB US$1,399 (originally US$1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB US$1,849 (originally US$1,999)

Rare clearance deal: Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 in medium and small sizes up to US$200 off

The brand-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 has officially gone on sale, with limited early-bird discounts available on various configurations. However, Amazon is also offering significantly cheaper discounts on the previous-generation but still excellent Apple Watch Ultra 3.

The Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the stunning Milanese Loop remains the most eye-catching deal — originally US$899, now available for nearly US$200 off. While this is the standout offer in this batch of clearance deals, other configurations are also discounted this morning.

However, note that other configurations are now priced the same as the premium Milanese Loop version mentioned above. But the nearly US$200 discount only applies to the large size, while medium and small sizes currently have US$100 off — these popular medium configurations are typically discounted less often:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 (with Alpine Loop) US$699 (originally US$799) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 (with Milanese Loop) US$799 (originally US$899) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 (with Trail Loop) US$699 (originally US$799) | Small

Once again, the large-size Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Milanese Loop remains the best value in this batch of deals, but given that medium-size deals can be genuinely hard to come by, we felt it worth a special mention.

Below are some Apple Watch Ultra 4 models with modest early-bird discounts:

Apple's brand-new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio is down US$50 on Amazon

In addition to the return of early-bird discounts on the more affordable M6 Mac mini, users looking to upgrade to Apple's more powerful 2026 Mac Studio launched earlier can now grab one on Amazon at a brand-new all-time low.

Amazon has now dropped the brand-new M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of storage to US$2,449 with free shipping.

This machine is originally US$2,499, so you're saving US$50. While the discount isn't massive, saving US$50 is still nice if you want to upgrade during the early days of release — and it's also US$1 cheaper than the pre-order deal.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB US$2,450 (originally US$2,499)

Amazon never officially sold the previous Mac Studio, so it's hard to predict the pricing trajectory for this model. So far, its early-bird deals are similar to those for the new M6 Mac mini, but Amazon tends to be quite aggressive with new Apple products during early sales periods, so it's unclear whether this professional-grade machine will see further discounts during Prime Day and Black Friday. It's certainly not impossible to see close to US$100 off before year-end, but for now we can't say for sure.

Either way, early buyers can save a bit, and friends who only need basic specs without the M5 Max performance and 36GB of RAM can also take advantage of the return of early-bird deals on specific configurations of the M6 Mac mini:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB US$880 (originally US$899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB US$1,070 (originally US$1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB US$1,270 (originally US$1,299)
